t_advice_summary_textbox.text: purple, pink, red and brown gnomes use the red basket. whereas the blue, green, yellow and orange gnomes use a yellow basket. use the same group of gnomes until the amount of mushrooms gets too low and then switch.

vb_textbox.text: the red, brown, purple and pink gnomes have the red basket. the green, yellow, orange and blue gnomes have the yellow basket. choose a colour basket to start with, and use the gnomes with that colour continuously until the number they collect gets low. Then, switch to the gnomes with the other colour basket, and continue the same. To remember which basket each have, remember the colour of the gnome is similar. Red, pink, purple and brown are all reddish shades. Blue, green, orange and yellow are all on the other side of the colour wheel and are yellowish shades. The strategy is not 100%, so try other things too to see what works best.
